annotations.text: Notary assistant checklist tool — flow: pick act type → dump uploads → AI verifies in background → assistant confirms low-confidence matches inline → case-level status always visible.
Core screen. Upload, verification, validation and status all live on ONE persistent view — no separate wizard steps 2-5, since documents trickle in over days and the assistant revisits constantly.
Responsive: banner stacks, single column, 44px+ touch targets, condensed top bar.
